title: Comfort-Call Addition on Late No-Heat and No-Cool Calls, Repair and Emergency Service Calls
content:
On Repair and Emergency Service Calls, a late technician on a no-heat or no-cool call adds a fixed comfort-call addition to the on-time credit. The symptom is read from the call record. For a member, the record read is the tier's no-heat and no-cool response guarantee under Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements; a tier whose guaranteed response hours are zero carries no such guarantee.

**Rule.** The comfort-call addition is 15 dollars on a no-heat or no-cool call of a customer with an active agreement whose tier carries no no-heat or no-cool response guarantee. It is 10 dollars on any other no-heat or no-cool call. It is nothing on calls for any other symptom.

**When it is added.** The addition is added to the on-time credit after the credit has been rounded to the cent, and the addition itself is never multiplied. In a call class whose on-time credit is zero, no addition is made.

## Questions answered

**A non-member's late no-cool call?** 10 dollars. That is "any other no-heat or no-cool call".

**A member whose tier carries a 12-hour no-heat response guarantee, late on a no-heat call?** 10 dollars, because the tier carries a response guarantee.

**A member whose tier carries no response guarantee, late on a no-cool call?** 15 dollars.

**A late call for poor airflow, a water leak or a thermostat issue?** Nothing.

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

A rounded on-time credit of $37.50 on a late no-heat call of a non-member becomes $37.50 and $10.00, which is $47.50.
